title: Amount Added for the Time a Car Rental Booking Was Held
content:
Where a Car Rental Rate Classes rental is given up, an amount may be added for how long the renter held the
booking before doing so. The days the booking was held are the calendar days from the date it was booked to
the date the renter gave it up.

1. Where the renter held the booking for 30 days or more before giving it up, the rate class's flat
   cancellation charge is added twice over, at a multiple of 2.
2. Where the renter held the booking for 7 days or more before giving it up, the rate class's flat
   cancellation charge is added once.
3. Where the renter held it for fewer than 7 days, nothing is added under this head.

The flat cancellation charge is the figure published by the rate class booked, and the amount added here is
that figure at the multiple the length of holding sets.

| Days the booking was held | Amount added |
| --- | --- |
| 30 or more | the rate class's flat cancellation charge twice over |
| 7 to 29 | the rate class's flat cancellation charge once |
| fewer than 7 | nothing |

## The edges of each row

A booking held for exactly 30 calendar days falls in the first row; one held for 29 days falls in the
second. A booking held for exactly 7 calendar days falls in the second row; one held for 6 days falls in the
third and adds nothing.

## Worked amounts

A hypothetical rental booked and given up 41 calendar days later, on a class whose flat cancellation charge
is 50 USD, adds 100 USD. The same rental given up 12 calendar days after it was booked adds 50 USD. Given up
4 calendar days after it was booked, it adds nothing.
